Scope Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-business-analyst under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Scope Gate.rationale: Scope is bounded: 9 in-scope items, 6 named exclusions, 10 acceptance criteria each naming an in-scope identifier and a verification method, 5 recorded scope decisions, and 0 blocking open questions. The boundary that matters most is drawn explicitly: D-003 and X-004 record that the mechanically checked guarantee is structural and identifier-level and that semantic equivalence is not asserted, so the artifact does not sell a guarantee the change cannot keep. X-001 keeps adding the capability separate from using it. The producer did not decide this gate.

Planning Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-tech-lead under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Planning Gate.rationale: Nine tasks across six waves, with an acyclic edge table from which the stated order recomputes exactly. Sequencing is feasible: wave 1 holds only tasks with no prerequisite, and the single external dependency blocks T-004's demonstration rather than the delivery path, which is the correct shape for an environment gap. Risk coverage is proportionate -- R-002 names the real hazard, that the judging rule is the only mechanical defence against a plausible-reading candidate that dropped a rule, and its mitigation is demonstration per loss class rather than an assertion of coverage. Two blocking validator findings were corrected before completion and are recorded in the result envelope. Q-001 and Q-002 are non-blocking and correctly left open. The producer did not decide this gate.

Design Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-tech-lead under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Design Gate.rationale: The selection is re-derivable from the option table: O-002 falls to hard constraint C-002, O-003 to C-003 and C-004, O-004 to C-004, leaving O-001 as the only option satisfying every hard constraint. D-001 is accepted: reusing the refactor lifecycle costs one discovery record and inherits five dispatchable phases with their gates and owners, and M-007, M-008, and M-009 are recorded as no-change-verified so the claim is checked rather than assumed. D-002 is accepted and is the load-bearing decision: acceptance rests on an executable invariant set, not on the producing model's assurance, and the contract is required to state the checked and unchecked guarantees separately. R-001 is the residual risk and is correctly owned rather than mitigated away; Q-001 keeps it open. Both records stay at Proposed until this gate; this decision accepts them. Sequencing was corrected on one charged retry to bind T-004 and T-008. The producer did not decide this gate.

Review Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-qa under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Review Gate.rationale: Both blocking correction requests are closed and their corrections re-executed: CR-001 confines every session write to the session directory with five regression tests fixing the defect's shape, and CR-002 stops a byte heuristic being reported through the column that claims measurement. The review earned its verdict rather than rubber-stamping: it re-executed the evidence instead of reading the implementation report's claims, and it found a genuine critical defect in the exact place the design flagged as owing the most care. Thirty-one of thirty-one automated checks pass; six of six coverage checks pass at the recorded baseline plus one command record. What remains is three low findings and two accepted risks, each with a named owner. The producer of the review package did not decide this gate.

Verification Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-qa under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Verification Gate.rationale: Verification is adequate for what the change claims and honest about what it does not reach. The judgement rule -- the acceptance basis the whole capability rests on -- is demonstrated per loss class, and the suite would fail both a rule that refused everything and one that accepted everything, so the coverage is discriminating rather than decorative. The denial boundary is exercised at every denied segment and by an argument that names one directly. The recovery path is exercised in all four outcomes. The one unexercised path, the live compression request, is disclosed in the design as A-002, in the implementation report as an unverified area, and in the review as F-004 with CR-004 owed before any pass is applied to a knowledge surface; its failure modes leave originals untouched, so the exposure is bounded. The implementation report stands at provisional and partially-verified, which is the accurate reading and the reason this gate approves progression rather than completion of verification.

Closure Gate.decided_by: vuhoangcao (operator, acting for omn-orchestrator under the Producer Exclusion Rule)
Closure Gate.rationale: All six phases executed and every artifact was accepted by its registered validator: scope-definition 33 of 33, execution-plan 45 of 45, technical-design 78 of 78 with two decision records, implementation-report 32 of 32, review-package 31 of 31, release-note 31 of 31. All five gates ahead of this one are decided, each by an owner who did not produce the evidence. Two charged retries were spent and both are recorded with what they repaired. The change is closed honestly rather than cleanly: the release verdict is partial, the implementation report stands at provisional, and three known issues ship with named tracking, including the one that matters most -- that the guarantee is structural and not semantic. Nothing is claimed that the run's evidence does not carry. The producer of the release note did not decide this gate.
